newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan anti narcotics team makes huge heroin haul.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan anti narcotics team makes huge heroin haul.

text.p: Pakistan's Anti-Narcotics Force (ANF) said on Thursday two people had been arrested and 500 kg (1,100 pounds) of heroin seized in Karachi.
An ANF official said the heroin had been found during a raid carried out in Karachi's wealthy Clifton area late on Wednesday night. He gave no estimate of its street value.
Full details of the huge heroin haul were due to be announced at a news conference later on Thursday, which the United Nations has designated as International Drug Day.
Narcotics smuggling is punishable by death under Pakistani law.
